note: Phase 3 Stage 2 retrain, per docs/prereg-phase3-retrain-2026-09-10.md §5 as amended. Architecture frozen (§5.1): no ladder, detector scale is a measured null. IR trains FIRST because it is the cheaper failure (~8h/seed vs ~27h) and the arm that has never been trained as the thing deployed (nc=1 ship-only, §2c) -- a surprise is likeliest there and costs least there. Ten runs, 5 seeds each arm (§5.2, confirmed against G4 in Amendment 4: the seeds average the training trajectory, they are NOT powering a two-arm test, and the 'retrained vs deployed' comparison is CUT and may not be reported). kind=gaussian with sigma=true throughout: §6's mechanism arms consume the sigma_ltrb the Gaussian head produces, so a plain detector would leave Stage 3 with nothing to test. VIS data is the _p04out yaml -- pohang04 is held out (G5) and the ORIGINAL data_vis_stride2.yaml would fail the gate this queue now runs before every invocation. IR needs no _p04out equivalent: pohang04 has no thermal labels at all (Amendment 2), so its lists were already clean. No mosaic-off ft continuation stage for either arm: every VIS base-to-ft pair on record finishes at or below the base checkpoint, and IR is not being given one asymmetrically.
